title: GOD'S BEAUTIFUL PROMISES

blocks.text: You can see by the worldwide situation and the definite important prophecies fulfilling we are at the very end of the age! “The former and the latter rain hath come together as one can see by the various news and TV reports!” As predicted with tremendous healings and miracles this will wind up quickly. The next thing you know the Translation could take place very soon, because already Israel’s Covenant is being prepared to get ready for Jesus’ return! “Rejoice, I say, rejoice forever more!” – Worldwide changes are taking place so swiftly that hardly anyone in the media or otherwise can keep up with what’s occurring!

There are some fantastic occurrences and happenings. In this special writing I want to increase your faith, joy and healing in God’s beautiful promises! We are living in exciting and wondrous times! This is more for our age than any right now and we read – Isa. 40:31, But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint. – “Wait means trust, patience and expect!” – The next words are akin to the Translation! They shall receive physical and spiritual strength with longer endurance and energy! There will not be one of the elect sick just before the change! Then the saints will be glorified suddenly!

Ps. 37:4-5, Delight thyself also in the Lord; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart. Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass. – “Delight means to be pleased and joyful in the Lord. – Commit means to truly give all your ways over to Him! He then will show you wonders!”

Read these closely, every one of these marvelous verses are personally for you! “Believe, act and take advantage of all his benefits!” – Ps. 103:1-5, Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name. Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thine diseases; Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with loving kindness and tender mercies; Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

Ps. 105:37, He brought them forth also with silver and gold; and there was not one feeble person among their tribes. – This also typifies the elect evidently! He will supply their needs until the last elect is in and out! – “And up ye shall go! Praise the Lord!” – Prov. 3:5-6, Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths. – In this one don’t ever wonder why some strange thing happened in your life or someone else’s life. – “Just put full confidence in the Scriptures and God will give you guidance, light and wisdom! Don’t trust human reasoning, but His way completely. Leave the questions and whys to Him!”

Mark 11:24, Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them. – “The key word is you must believe that you have it before you see it. – It is a finished work, but you must believe and accept it until manifestation. Again, trust is used! – St. John 15:7, If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you. – “Sometimes miracles will occur quickly, sometimes you must have patience! But an answer will be given as you rest, live and act in His Word!” – I John 1:9, If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. – “It reveals here God is more faithful to forgive, then people are ready to confess their faults or sins! Be steadfast!”

We now enter some prophetic promises. – II Peter 1:19, We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts. – The day star we know is Christ. But we know the heavens are declaring His coming! Even the scientists say they have never seen such awesome signs! The gap in narrowing, Jesus is coming! – It definitely means we will have a clearer picture and will be more sure than ever of His coming as He has given more light out of dark passages! James 5:7-8, Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain. Be ye also patient; establish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh. – “The former and the latter rain are now falling together! We will soon see the redeeming rainbow around the throne! (Translation) – These are days of rejoicing!”

It will take the world by surprise, but not the elect! Here are some conclusive evidence of His Word. Angels said it – This same “Jesus” shall so come. (Acts 1:11) – Catch this, Paul said, The Lord Himself shall descend. (I Thess. 4:16) – So we see who Jesus is! – Christ Himself declared that He would come again. (St. John 14:1-3) and would be glorified in His saints! – The Word says it this way, “As a thief in the night.” (I Thess. 5:2) – As a lightning flash. (Matt. 24:27) – He will return suddenly! (Mark 13:36) – Jesus said, behold I come quickly. (Rev. 22:7) In fact, He said it three different times in Rev. 22. – This reveals that right now forward prophetic events will occur in rapid speed and this is exactly what is appearing around the globe now! – Our transition is running out, this is our time! Go ye out to meet Him! In an hour ye think not! Behold make yourself ready. – Read Luke 6:38 – He will over shower you with His blessings, because immediately He putteth in the sickle! “And He will prosper and supply your needs because only a short time is left in reaping the harvest!”
